notes.title: Version 2022.10.01
notes.notes:
An update with couple of fixes, namely:


 FIX: Fixed stored angles for respective launchers
 FIX: Gamepad Virtual cursor
 FIX: level finished dialog second time open
 FIX: exit dialog too small
 FIX: pause twice from main menu
 FIX: cursor disappears in model dialogs
 FIX: closing Exit dialog with ESC closes main menu

notes.title: Early Access Version!
notes.notes:
First version available for Early Access! this version works as complete as we expect to have by the October 20th. In the meanwhile, we are seeking for bugs and fixing them, and adding more languages supported on the way :)

Have fun, and please provide feedback!!
